name: Outlaw Tools v0.9.0
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.9.0

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.9.0

## Saved Routes

- Build named routes from Shopping needs, refinery orders and tracked or observed missions. Choose a starting stop and group tasks by location; this is not a fastest-travel calculation.
- Keep exact quantities, units, QL and source evidence. Unknown localities and unsupported raw/refined conversions stay unresolved. Mining exclusions remain in place.
- Save, reopen, edit and delete plans. Complete, skip, defer and resume progress manually. Progress never changes stock or proves a game event; changed goals reset progress.
- Open existing source workflows. Refinery links find the exact order across filters and pages.

## Player Data

- Routes support portable export, reviewed import and direct own-PC sync, with reviewable whole-plan conflicts and replay protection.
- Update both PCs. Use Settings > Prepare this PC to review enabling route sync on an existing link. A verified backup is retained; peer links, history and acknowledgements stay intact.
- Player data stays on PCs. Storage upgrades preserve existing data; older archives remain readable. Linux continues to use manual transfer.
- Refreshed bundled ship fitting, FPS equipment and crafting snapshots with per-source patch/build provenance, plus economy identity/cache corrections.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums.
